title: Creator Rewards — A More Personal Reward

scenes.voice: A creator brings a customer to your store. What if the reward felt as personal as the recommendation?
Meet Creator Rewards. Connect your creator partnerships with personalized product rewards, funded by a budget you control.
A fan chooses a creator design, then adds a personal detail. Arcade generates a personalized product preview. Their story, with their own finishing touch.
Bring the collection into the shopping experience. Our Shopify prototype shows how a customer can discover a reward while browsing your store.
You set the economics: creator commission, the reward budget, and your contribution target. Explore the model before committing to a pilot.
Start with one store and one creator. Then measure contribution per referred visitor against your current affiliate offer.
Make your next creator partnership more personal. Creator Rewards. Let's talk about a pilot.
